license: GPL-2.0-only with the libgit2 linking exception (see COPYING)
sourceFormat: Selected upstream C sources, generated CMake headers, local port patch and relative include rewriting; no precompiled library is distributed.

profile.https: mbedTLS, ESP certificate bundle REQUIRED, hostname verified
profile.regex: PCRE2 with session allocator, bounded pattern/nesting/backtracking and cooperative cancellation
profile.transportExposed: HTTPS only; no URL credentials, redirects or proxy

patchSummary: FAT replacement journal and fsync compatibility, missing POSIX adaptations, hardware random source
Cooperative cancellation for I/O, network polling and PCRE2; smaller stack buffers
OS certificate bundle with strict hostname verification; TLS initialization error cleanup
zlib and PCRE2 use Git session allocator; regex limits and reduced initial compiler buffers
Initialization rollback for sysdir, built-in filters and merge drivers after allocation failure
External process creation disabled on ESP
0.8.26: skip TLS startup for local Git commands; release failed TLS wrappers without double-destroying their sockets.
0.8.29: use int local repeat counters in PCRE2 read_repeat_counts to match the read_number(int*) API under GCC RISC-V, preserving count bounds and behavior.
0.8.29: align libgit2 internal action pointers, 32-bit parsing temporaries and local transport progress callback types for GCC RISC-V; preserve public signatures and error paths.
0.8.33: verify SO_ERROR after a writable nonblocking connect; retry the next resolved address after connection refusal instead of starting TLS on a failed socket.
limitations: Desktop interop and failure injection do not replace device SD/USB power-loss and stack high-water measurements.
The bounded session arena explicitly reclaims orphaned libgit2 allocations on failed operations after final shutdown; this is not a proof that every upstream OOM path releases non-memory resources.

additionalPatches.reason: read_repeat_counts local counter types must match read_number(int*) on GCC RISC-V, where int32_t is long. Counts (<=65535) and unlimited sentinel (65536) fit int; no pointer cast or disabled diagnostic.
Align internal pointer and callback types with explicit int32_t/uint32_t API contracts on GCC RISC-V. Public signatures remain unchanged; temporary values are copied only after successful parsing.
